text: ぼくが　なに　やってるか　わかる？

structure.jp: ぼくが　なに　やってるか

patterns.name: 〜か (embedded question)
patterns.span: なに　やってるか　わかる
patterns.explanation: A question ending in か can sit inside a bigger sentence, before a verb like わかる. なに　やってるか　わかる = 'do you know what I'm doing'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says an action is going on right now; てる is the shortened spoken form. やってる = 'am doing'.
